name: reality-fx-os-android
description: The Android wrapper for the Reality FX Trading Academy OS — a Capacitor shell around the existing web OS. Never a rebuild: the RFX brain stays exactly where it lives.

scripts.android:sync: bash scripts/build-web.sh && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:dev: bash scripts/build-web.sh && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: bash scripts/build-web.sh && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
